source_issues.title: 范数诱导距离、Lp定义域与单位球边界
source_issues.note: 并非任意距离函数都可表示为向量差的范数；Lp需p>=1才通常为范数；单位球应含内部而源给等号集合。
source_issues.evidence: Read and preserved exact claims; independent finite arithmetic: p=.5 gives ||(1,1)||=4 > ||(1,0)||+||(0,1)||=2.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; distinguish source limitation from translation accuracy.

source_issues.title: 余弦距离非一般度量及零向量
source_issues.note: 1-cos不满足三角不等式，平行不同向量距离为零，零向量公式未定义。文档长度与方向关系依赖表示模型，不可泛化所有现代embedding。
source_issues.evidence: For unit vectors at 0,45,90 degrees, d(0,90)=1 > d(0,45)+d(45,90)=2-sqrt(2). Finite arithmetic only.
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; distinguish source limitation from translation accuracy.

source_issues.title: 较大模长必有更高点积
source_issues.note: 点积分数还依赖角度符号；负方向增大模长使分数更低。源在固定相同正向相似度等前提下才可概括。
source_issues.translation_treatment: Faithfully retained; distinguish source limitation from translation accuracy.

source_issues.title: 正则化、鲁棒性与损失等同距离的泛化
source_issues.note: L1线性惩罚不保证单一巨大值不主导；L1并非所有训练方法都会精确稀疏，Ridge缩放非所有方向统一且可能有零系数。MAE/MSE的平均轴应按定义区分；并非所有loss是距离，CE与KL差H(P)，优化器权重衰减也非一律L2惩罚。译文未偷偷改源。
source_issues.evidence: Independent source reading; not a translation change request.
